cols['sin t']=np.sin(t)
cols['cos t']=np.cos(t)
names=list(cols)
A=np.c_[[cols[n] for n in names]].T
# greedy forward selection
sel=[]
for step in range(6):
    bestv=None
    for n in names:
        if n in sel: continue
        B=np.c_[[cols[m] for m in sel+[n]]].T
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        e=np.mean((dP_dt-B@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
        if bestv is None or e<bestv[0]: bestv=(e,n)
    sel.append(bestv[1]); print(step,bestv)
